rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that is upsetting or emotionally distressing.

example.english: This news story is really distressing.
example.traditional: 呢單新聞真係令人難受。
example.jyutping: nei1 daan1 san1 man4 zan1 hai6 ling4 jan4 naan4 sau6

rows.note: Use this when the distress mainly makes people feel sad or sorrowful.

example.english: Their leaving us was really distressing.
example.traditional: 佢離開咗我哋，真係令人難過。
example.jyutping: keoi5 lei4 hoi1 zo2 ngo5 dei6 zan1 hai6 ling4 jan4 naan4 gwo3

rows.note: Use this when the distress comes from something unsettling, worrying, or anxiety-inducing.

example.english: Hearing strange noises every night is distressing.
example.traditional: 夜晚成日聽到怪聲，令人不安。
example.jyutping: je6 maan5 seng4 jat6 teng1 dou2 gwaai3 seng1 ling4 jan4 bat1 on1

rows.note: Use this for a distressing or appalling sight that is almost too horrible to look at.

example.english: The scene of the car crash was distressing.
example.jyutping: ce1 wo6 jin6 coeng4 caam2 bat1 jan2 dou2
